storyInfo: The Rhodes Islanders arrive at Deity Grypherburg at the appointed hour in search of the Sarcophagus, and are accompanied by Eloysius to the palace. The Generalik and Hierda head together towards Zelgrad—an Ursine city that has opened itself to the Infected.

attributes.content: A land of eternity without suffering... The ultimate hope for the future, spoken of in ancient legends.
attributes.name: Priestess

attributes.content: But nobody could have foreseen that when we gazed upon the border of the universe, we would realize asking for a future was the unreasonable part of the demand.
attributes.name: Priestess

attributes.content: Dr. {@nickname}... The you you are now, the you who has seen the devastation plaguing this planet for yourself—
attributes.name: Priestess

attributes.content: What sort of future do you still hope for?
attributes.name: Priestess

attributes.content: *sigh*...
attributes.name: Priestess

attributes.content: PRTS's functionality is limited, the PCS system is completely destroyed, and DWDB-221E is also lost... There are not many tools we can use left.
attributes.name: Priestess

attributes.content: Did you expect things to turn out this way?
attributes.name: Priestess

attributes.content: Friston, Ed, Lu...
attributes.name: Priestess

attributes.content: I cherish the time we worked together. I was greatly looking forward to seeing what hopeful answers you could find.
attributes.name: Priestess

attributes.content: But it is a shame. Time has shown just how futile your efforts were, how fruitless they turned out... though they are still worthy of respect.
attributes.name: Priestess

attributes.content: ...How I regret that things have come to this.
attributes.name: Priestess

attributes.content: Allow me to borrow your legacy one last time. My plans for the future never did obtain your complete approval, but at the very least, we can still have a future.
attributes.name: Priestess

attributes.content: Perhaps, in this future, we shall meet again.
attributes.name: Priestess

attributes.content: <p=1>New Rhodes Island, Operator Dormitory</> <p=2>Early December, 1101</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.content: It is the deep of night.
Amiya silently sits on the edge of her bed, unable to sleep.
The room is brand-new, the air exceedingly fresh.
The narrow space is laid out almost exactly the same as its original. She has no need to change any of her minute, unconscious habits that have built up over the years.
But ever since she moved in, she has not enjoyed a good night's sleep.
A faint sigh.
Amiya...
attributes.name: Civilight Eterna

attributes.content: Theresa? No, I wasn't calling for you...
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: ...Did... Did you hear me earlier?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: I live in your consciousness, Amiya. There is no need for you to lie to yourself.
attributes.name: Civilight Eterna

attributes.content: It is rather late. Shouldn't you be asleep?
attributes.name: Civilight Eterna

attributes.content: Mon3tr and Closure, they're... They're doing the last bit of theory-testing before we bring back Dr. Kal'tsit.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: There's nothing I can do to help directly, but I also can't get any rest like this... Though I did promise the Doctor I would.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: But...
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: I am always around if you need to get things off your chest, Amiya.
attributes.name: Civilight Eterna

attributes.content: I know everyone's working their hardest to bring Dr. Kal'tsit back. I need to stay strong too.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: It's a strange feeling. The day the incident happened, I thought we had lost her forever.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: But then Mon3tr appeared, and she told us there was still a possibility of bringing her back, a sliver of hope...
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: It feels just like... that first time in the ruins of Londinium... when I saw Theresa.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: I still remember it clearly. What I felt at the time was certainly not joy...
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: I'm sorry, Theresa.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: It's alright, Amiya.
attributes.name: Civilight Eterna

attributes.content: We have already said our farewells to Theresa, have we not?
attributes.name: Civilight Eterna

attributes.content: Right...
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: I'm not too sure, and I dare not believe... If we really do manage to 'bring back' Dr. Kal'tsit, will the person who returns be her?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: You should know, Amiya, that Kal'tsit is different from everyone else.
attributes.name: Civilight Eterna

attributes.content: Mon3tr said Kal'tsit has been through this sort of thing before.
attributes.name: Civilight Eterna

attributes.content: Perhaps what we consider a miracle truly can come to pass?
attributes.name: Civilight Eterna

attributes.content: But after all our time together, Dr. Kal'tsit's basically a part of my family. I can't even imagine how she could be any different from us.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Theresa, can you tell me one of your stories about you and her? From long ago.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: I want to know what sort of person she is in your eyes.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: I can only tell you about the memories Theresa has of Kal'tsit, Amiya. I am unqualified to tell you a story in her stead.
attributes.name: Civilight Eterna

attributes.content: I do not believe that is what you want, either.
attributes.name: Civilight Eterna

attributes.content: You're right. Maybe... Maybe I just want to hear Dr. Kal'tsit's voice again...
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: She's taken care of me for so long, and taught me so much... but when I think about it, I know very little about her.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: I had so many questions I wanted to ask her and Theresa... but they were all such serious questions. I couldn't give them any more burdens to bear.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Maybe... when they thought the time was right, they would've told me of their own accord.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: But the right time never came.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: I understand. Theresa and Kal'tsit were both very important to you.
attributes.name: Civilight Eterna

attributes.content: You do not need to hide your emotions from me, Amiya, nor should you bear everything alone. Go and tell Closure and Mon3tr, and the Doctor.
attributes.name: Civilight Eterna

attributes.content: No matter how things may turn out, you should not leave behind any regrets, alright?
attributes.name: Civilight Eterna

attributes.content: You're right... I'll be fine, Theresa. Once I step out of this room, I'll be back to normal.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Don't worry. No matter what comes to pass, I won't let Closure and Mon3tr see any dismay on my face.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: But I cannot help but worry about you, Amiya.
attributes.name: Civilight Eterna

attributes.content: You have had far less sleep than usual this past month. You must get more rest.
attributes.name: Civilight Eterna

attributes.content: You should also be aware that ever since you used the Black Crown's power in Ursus, your vital signs have all been very abnormal.
attributes.name: Civilight Eterna

attributes.content: Not only that, but you have been avoiding routine Rhodes Island medical checkups ever since Kal'tsit left us.
attributes.name: Civilight Eterna

attributes.content: I can also tell that... some changes started even before that.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: When the Doctor and I were exploring Civilight Eterna, we discovered a model from the Slumber Bridge project, and borrowed its power to fight Priestess.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: I don't fully understand it yet, but I can sense that this model seems to have linked me even closer to the Black Crown.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: I can use the power of the Lord of Fiends more easily, I can sense emotions more intensely. Sometimes, I can even hear voices, and I can't shut them out.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: It's like... I'm back to before Dr. Kal'tsit gave me these rings.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: I am detecting that the connection between you and the Black Crown is deepening at a rapid pace. This is unprecedented in the entire line of the Kings of Sarkaz.
attributes.name: Civilight Eterna

attributes.content: I cannot explain its cause, but it is not something to take lightly, no matter what it may be.
attributes.name: Civilight Eterna

attributes.content: You must take care, Amiya. I believe you should let the Doctor know as soon as possible.
attributes.name: Civilight Eterna

attributes.content: Right... I understand.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: I promise I'll pay close attention to my condition, but is it okay if we don't tell the Doctor right now?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Was that Closure's workstation?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Have they finally gotten results...?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: <p=1>New Rhodes Island Engineering Department</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.content: Alright, after squashing I-don't-know how many bugs, I can finally say with certainty that there's no problems in the entire dataset.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Here goes! I'm praying this is the last simulation we have to run!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: This time, it'll be a success...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Aye dun dink dere'll be enny broblems et al—
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: Hey, Mon3tr, don't move, or the data cables on your head will fall off!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Keep her still, Warfarin, then help me inspect the simulation life pod's cables, make sure they're all connected properly.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Alright, alright...
attributes.name: Warfarin

attributes.content: You seriously think I understand any of this...? Never had to deal with this sort of stuff in Medical.
attributes.name: Warfarin

attributes.content: Look, I had to start from scratch too when I was studying all that data from Mon3tr! Forget it, all systems green here, no need to check!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Alright, everyone ready?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Here goes—
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: One minute, two minutes... Ten minutes pass, each one an eternity longer than the last, all without any warning pop-ups or worrying flashes of red.
Cmoncmoncmoncmon—
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Don't...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: (Deep breath)
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: No, it will make it!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: This is all based on reasonable assumptions and a carefully calculated foundation, and it's in accordance with that 'life-phase transition' stuff she was going on about, so even if all we can get is a glimmer...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: ...Even if all we can see is a glimmer of hope, I'll be happy.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: The Vampire's red eyes stare at the monitor, unblinking. The fluorescence reflects off Closure's pale face as a series of pinpricks of light, the process's various readings constantly in flux.
The progress bar on the monitor stops, just as it is about to reach the end.
It's—
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: ...Working?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Failure. Again.
After so many failures, she should already have gotten used to seeing this result, yet defeat still weighs heavy on her heart.
Closure looks towards the scarlet glare, subconsciously trying to use the naked eye to pick out the true cause of the issue from the morass of data.

But what made her despair the most was the fact that she had checked over every key snippet of code countless times over. If every step was performed correctly, but still didn't result in success, then doesn't that mean...
Where's the problem this time? This shouldn't be happening—
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: Don't look so glum.
attributes.name: Warfarin

attributes.content: Nobody's done bioengineering this complicated before. We must've missed a spot somewhere.
attributes.name: Warfarin

attributes.content: Calm down, keep looking, and you'll definitely find it.
attributes.name: Warfarin

attributes.content: I know, I'm not giving up yet.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Drone No. 6, begin recording progress reports 1860 to 1864.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Project: Sarcophagus Resurrection Experiment. Progress: 0.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: But why...?
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: Our last two attempts should've succeeded. Even if Kal'tsit severed the connection between us, there are other methods we can theoretically use to replace the gemini cycle's information transmission function.
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: I stored all the memories Kal'tsit encoded as energy strings inside. Every single one of the Sarcophagus's parameters is correct.
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: Using 'Oka', blank Originium, as the base of Kal'tsit's reconstructed body is theoretically feasible...
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: But where's the issue? What are we missing...?
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: Maybe...
attributes.name: Warfarin

attributes.content: The same thought floats through everyone's minds, but none of them dare say it out loud.

attributes.options: Maybe what we're missing is...
The part that makes Kal'tsit Kal'tsit.

attributes.content: Doctor? You're here!
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: Sorry, we couldn't—
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.options: It's alright. We expected to run into difficulties.;Though this outcome is a little disappointing.

attributes.content: Don't... Don't lose heart just yet, Doctor!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Rhodes Island's best engineer hasn't given up! With Terra's genius hacker on your side, making sense of the data Kal'tsit left behind is a done deal! On the honor of my spot in the Kazdel's Elite 100—
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: I will find a way to bring Kal'tsit back!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.options: If that's how you feel, I've got nothing to worry about.;Wasn't I meant to be the one giving the pep talk?

attributes.content: I mean, you did look a little disappointed just now.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: I promised Kal'tsit I wouldn't let you or Amiya handle all the pressure by yourselves anymore.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.options: Thank you, Closure.
Rhodes Island still needs Kal'tsit.;We're all hoping she can come back to us.

attributes.content: Yeah!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.options: By the way, news from Ursus.;Crownslayer found more clues about the Sarcophagus.
It's time to set off again.
Maybe once we actually find it...

attributes.content: <p=1>Rhodes Island Temporary Treatment Center, Odoyev Raion, Deity Grypherburg</> <p=2>January 1102</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.content: You see... This w-wounded joint... If you... set it like this... It won't hurt.
attributes.name: Vetochki

attributes.content: Spasibo, Vetochki! I'm feeling better already!
attributes.name: Haggard Infected

attributes.content: I learned... it from Rhodes... Island's d-doctors.
attributes.name: Vetochki

attributes.content: Speaking of, this Deity Grypherburg place sure is something, having stoves like these we can warm ourselves with. No wonder those nobles can sit pretty in the cities without caring about winter.
attributes.name: Haggard Infected

attributes.content: Can we really settle down here, Vetochki?
attributes.name: Haggard Infected

attributes.content: It's... okay. Raidian said sh-she'd protect us.
attributes.name: Vetochki

attributes.content: Now... we don't... need to be afraid.
attributes.name: Vetochki

attributes.content: Good grief, it's absolutely freezing here...
Can't you add a little more firewood—My apologies. What I meant to say is, if you are still lacking in firewood, I will be happy to help.
Is she... Imperial Guard? What're the Imperial Guard doing here?
attributes.name: Haggard Infected

attributes.content: D-Don't be scared!
attributes.name: Vetochki

attributes.content: She... Sh-She helped us before... Don't you remember?
attributes.name: Vetochki

attributes.content: Thank you, Vetochki. Thank you for speaking up for me, and thank you for remembering me.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: *sigh*... And after we forged a friendship in the fires of egress, too. I think my heart's beginning to break.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: You only have your conspicuous uniform to blame, 'Sergeant'.
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: I'm terribly sorry, but I am no lord with the time to change outfits for every single errand. I need this uniform as my free pass through other parts of Grypherburg.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: It's been a while since I last dropped by to say hello. Everything still going smoothly? How are your medicine stocks?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Hmm, our other supplies are just barely enough, but you know it's nearly impossible to obtain anti-Oripathy medication in the capital, and we're too far from our headquarters to transport more here.
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: If it wasn't for the matter of the Originium vein, the construction of Grypherburg's Oripathy medicine production line would've been on the agenda.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Who would have thought...
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Well, whatever the case, thank you for offering us this shelter.
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: I did make a promise. And it is simply an idle factory owned by my family. Even then, it still can't fit everyone inside... It is far too cold here.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Although the paperwork to shelter the Infected has been sorted out, now is not a good time for any of you to wander about the city.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: I regret to say that... as things stand, I have no way of offering you better conditions.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: I know they're only allowed to stay in Grypherburg as key witnesses to the tragedy of the Far North... even though this trial has not yet manifested itself.
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: This does not change the fact that there is nowhere in this nation for them.
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: ...That may change, sooner than you think.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Sorry, did you say something?
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: No, nothing. Let's shelve this discussion for later. I came to Rhodes Island today for another matter.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Where is that 'Doctor' of yours right now?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: <p=1>Rhodes Island Deity Grypherburg Branch Office, Ursus</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.options: Zelgrad?

attributes.content: Yep. Based on your team's intelligence, we can assume Ursus is secretly researching the Sarcophagus somewhere near Grypherburg.
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: And according to Crownslayer's info, we've found a few clues that can validate this assumption.
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: Despite Ursus's critical Originium shortage, there's a delivery of vast amounts of Originium from the city to the outskirts, same time, every day. Always in the same direction.
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: Their Originium logistics channels are well-hidden, and it's a bad idea for us to chase them too closely. But we've checked all the satellite cities around the capital, and none of them have the sort of industry that needs this much Originium.
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: None except the satellite city where the First Army is stationed. Zelgrad.
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: But the moment any lead we have points here, it's cut off. Guess Grypherburg is putting a lot of effort into hiding the flow of energy.
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.options: Nobody's mentioned this city to us during our time in Grypherburg.

attributes.content: You're not the only ones in the dark. Most Ursines are barely even aware Zelgrad exists.
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.options: Ursus must have a good reason to keep a secret like that.

attributes.content: We can also assume that, if large quantities of Originium go missing at a time like this, there's probably industry magnates who aren't too happy about it.
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: What's more, the Fourth Army's pretty much at the gates. They definitely have spies watching every move happening in Grypherburg.
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: But that's the reason why one thing really stands out.
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: Zelgrad is supposed to be a closed-off special district, but it's recently been advertising itself as 'a safe haven for the Infected'.
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: Their public statement is that the First Army firmly denounces the tragedy that happened in the Far Northern mines, so they are willing to shelter those Infected who lost their homes during the unrest.
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: 'As a show of the absolute kindness the tsar has for the Infected.'
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: Naturally, the first reaction everyone had on hearing this news was suspicion. We've been unable to get any information about any Infected who enter Zelgrad.
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: We've also found some issues with the records Crownslayer found in the district gates. Once you factor out the outsourced materials being used as cover, imports of pharmaceutical products and raw materials are almost nil.
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: None of this is concrete evidence, though. If we really want to know the truth, I'm afraid our only choice is an on-site inspection.
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: That's all the clues my side can offer you at the moment. We'll keep up our work at the edges of Grypherburg, and get as much information as we can into your hands.
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: Oh, right. Don't forget to tell the little USSG cubs what good work they've done next time you see them, Doctor.
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: Not just for their information-gathering skills. They were amazing during the recent crisis in Grypherburg. They're all bona-fide, grown-up Rhodes Island operators now.
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.options: I will. Everyone did great.;You're all the best of Rhodes Island's operators.
Thank you, Dur-nar.;Remember to tell Zima and her crew to stay safe.

attributes.content: Kal'tsit sealed away the Sarcophagus's core when she was in Chernobog. Theoretically speaking, Ursus's current technological know-how isn't enough for them to restart it.
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: What's stranger is, shouldn't Ursus be trying to turn it into an energy source at a time like this? Why do the opposite and consume tons of Originium? What are they actually trying to do?
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: Doctor, what I'm most worried about is Zelgrad accepting the Infected.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: I know this isn't a rational assessment, but... I find it very hard to believe the First Army is letting them in out of the goodness of their hearts.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.options: An incredibly suspicious act.;Our top priority is gathering even more intelligence about Zelgrad.
Closure...?

attributes.content: What are you doing, Closure?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Ah, sorry, just a sec, nearly done. Let's see what secrets this website is hiding.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Wait... Are you hacking into an Ursine government website?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Nonono, no hacking involved. The site I'm looking at is the 'Ursus State Council Executive Department Website'. The service-level news is for the public.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Government news, Catastrophe warnings... Ah, there it is, Zelgrad's notice saying they'll shelter Infected. Man, too many network fluctuations, filtering and download speeds are real slow.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: But what's obvious is that a lot of this is just fake news to keep up with appearances.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Check this city migration schedule, for example. If this info is true, it means there's been three nomadic city collisions near Grypherburg just last month!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: This sort of forgery definitely means they're hiding something. Just need to dig a little deeper...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Are you sure you're not crossing a line here, Closure?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: I'm not! Well... Maybe a little?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: But whoever kludged together this website clearly isn't very good at network security. The website's server is directly connected to their internal database.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Nothing too important in here, all just basic info on city routes. But Zelgrad's urban identification code is in here, as well as their public logistics and transportation records.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Okay, give me three minutes, and ZOOT will calculate the optimal route from Grypherburg to Zelgrad.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: I won't leave any tracks behind, guaranteed!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: But all we have is a lock on the satellite city's position. How are we meant to get in?
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: A direct attack? I don't have any issues with that, honestly...
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: If the Sarcophagus is in the hands of the First Army, that means it'll be heavily guarded. A direct attack is out of the question.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Doctor, I'm wondering if we can take advantage of Zelgrad admitting Infected—
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.options: A heads-up from Raidian—;Take care. Looks like someone's here.

attributes.content: Raidian... and Lieutenant Gorchekova?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: I happened to run into her. She says she has something to discuss with the Doctor, face-to-face.
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: It's been quite a while, my friends.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Though I do not believe I have met you before, Gospozha... Vampire?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Y'know, it's been so long since anyone's mentioned it that I practically forgot I am a Vampire.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.options: Her name is Closure.
She's an amazing engineer.;She's an amazing hacker.

attributes.content: It is my honor to meet you, Gospozha Closure.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: It is clear that you are an excellent... Hmm...
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Hmm...?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Eloysius turns to Raidian, choosing to communicate using sign language.
'Is this place safe?'
I don't detect any signals of dubious origin. Closure can also guarantee we are free to speak here.
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: Wha? Sorry, I don't understand sign language—
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Everything here was wired by us, correct?
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: Yeah?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: (Quietly) Does this mean nobody is monitoring us right now...?
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: Oh, definitely not. You don't have to worry about that sort of thing when I'm here.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Just act like you're back on the ship—err, back at HQ. You're welcome, by the way.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Spasibo. Then let us get down to brass tacks. Our last discussion ended on the topic of the Sarcophagus's whereabouts.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: In regards to intelligence on the matter, I have made some... not-so-small headway.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.options: Thank you for being willing to share it with us.

attributes.content: Yet another promise of mine. All part of our cooperative agreement.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Besides, even if I did not share this information with you, I'm sure you would already be trying all sorts of ways to get into Zelgrad, as is typical for you Rhodes Islanders.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.options: We will abide by the laws of Deity Grypherburg.;I assure you, we won't do anything illegal.

attributes.content: Eep..!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: A beep on the terminal draws Amiya's attention as the Vampire instinctively covers the screen. The young Imperial Guardswoman looks, but makes no comment.
Very well. I know full well just how difficult it is to establish a relationship built upon trust.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: But I insist on recommending Rhodes Island secure a legitimate status for your operations... for there will be many bumps on the road ahead.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: She's right. Rhodes Island must be well-prepared.
Are you... General Khratov?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Just Hellagur is fine.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: According to the Doctor's instructions, I have attempted to contact, and succeeded in contacting a Vice Chairman of the State Council, Vasily Gorchikov.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: In Grypherburg's eyes, Rhodes Island is on sound legal footing.
attributes.name: Hellagur
Eloysius
attributes.content: So it was your idea all along. I was wondering why...

attributes.name: Eloysius
attributes.content: Wait, how did you know he would be able to meet with the vice chairman—with Father?

attributes.options: It's simple. Because we could.;It was Operator Hellagur who suggested it in the first place.

attributes.content: It seems I have been underestimating the intelligence and contacts Rhodes Island has access to this whole time...
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: If that's the case, I have no more worries. Allow me to formally pass on this invitation to Rhodes Island.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: An invitation from His Imperial Majesty Fyodor Vladimirovich.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: This is why I have come here today. Now, allow me to escort you to the audience chamber.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: You're here.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: Do your clothes fit? Come closer, and let me see.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: Hmm. At least they fit you better than your old clothes.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: Thank you. They fit fine, and they're comfortable.
attributes.name: Cautus

attributes.content: You are my guest. This is the least of what I can provide you. If there is anything else you need, please do not hesitate to ask my adjutant.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: How is Anatoliy, Yasha?
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: The Generalik is currently choosing his retinue for the next operation.
attributes.name: Diligent Servant

attributes.content: He simply cannot wait, can he? Remind him to pick strong young recruits, no more wily old soldiers.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: I already have, ma'am.
attributes.name: Diligent Servant

attributes.content: Very good.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: What is your name? I cannot be calling you 'child' the entire time.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: Hierda. I'm called Hierda, ma'am.
attributes.name: Cautus

attributes.content: Well then, young Hierda.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: As I must remain here to maintain discipline, I need you to accompany my son to Zelgrad as his 'doctor'.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: He is going there to patrol, and look after the city. In turn, I hope you can look after him.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: You should know that Ursus has recently run into misfortune. The unrest continues to spread unabated, and the number of people who want him dead rivals the number who want to snatch my authority away from me.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: I want you to stay by his side and protect him, and once all the dust has settled, bring him back to me safe and sound.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: ...'Once all the dust has settled'?
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: You need only reply. Can you do this?
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: I need to know where my companions are first, and if they are safe.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: How careless of me. I forgot to tell you that they have already headed onwards.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: 'Onwards'?
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: To Zelgrad. The city is now open to both the public and the Infected. Your companions are the first lucky few to be accepted by this new policy.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: Once you go there, you may meet with them.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: ...What's this?
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: I'm sure I was here earlier, but he's not here.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: (This ship is too large. Where am I supposed to find the young general?)
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Hmm...
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: ...drat...
attributes.name: Faint Voice

attributes.content: Ah, someone's there.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Hello, may I ask—
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: ...Everyone knows being one of his bodyguards is a death sentence. Who's still willing to go?
attributes.name: Enraged Officer

attributes.content: And now he's actually managed to figure out he just needs to pick some nobody greenhorns who don't know what they're getting into—
attributes.name: Enraged Officer

attributes.content: How shameless!
attributes.name: Enraged Officer

attributes.content: (Quietly) Shh, keep it down! Let's talk somewhere else, I know where we can avoid the cameras.
attributes.name: Determined Officer

attributes.content: I had to let it all out today.
attributes.name: Enraged Officer

attributes.content: (Quietly) I get it, I get it, bratan. This is why we need to keep getting our people into his personal guard, even if it means sending them to the slaughterhouse.
attributes.name: Determined Officer

attributes.content: (Quietly) The marshal's clearly lost her ability to judge the situation. She thinks that with the new weapon, we can sleep peacefully at night, but she doesn't know the real problem was on the inside all along.
attributes.name: Determined Officer

attributes.content: (Quietly) Letting a useless boy play toy soldiers with the army just to earn some cheap glory, waving a live blade around like it's an emperor's scepter!
attributes.name: Determined Officer

attributes.content: (Quietly) She even lets him randomly execute the men without penalty... It's absolutely ridiculous.
attributes.name: Determined Officer

attributes.content: She keeps going on about how we have to do it for Ursus, but today's killing was certainly not for Ursus!
attributes.name: Enraged Officer

attributes.content: (Quietly) And if things keep going on like this, how're we supposed to deal with rebels? There was a Corporal Andrei in my barracks, all he did was follow the Marshal's orders to stop him, and he got his throat slashed open for it.
attributes.name: Determined Officer

attributes.content: (Quietly) Andrei wasn't even part of that 'Death Squad'. I had a look at his corpse, his eyes wide open, just a kid with a confused look on his face under the mortician's sheet...
attributes.name: Determined Officer

attributes.content: We've got to do something already!
attributes.name: Enraged Officer

attributes.content: (Quietly) You're right...
attributes.name: Determined Officer

attributes.content: We need to act.
attributes.name: Determined Officer

attributes.content: 'Act'?
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: What do they mean by...?
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Act?
attributes.name: Hierda
